findings.title: Producer JSON BLOB is destroyed before request parsing
findings.actual: Go Bytes(request) is []byte and idempotency.body is BLOB. rows() replaces bytes with a digest object, then request path asserts str. C fixture with SQL BLOB fails at line73. The consume-body JSON path has the same issue.
findings.fix: Decode bounded UTF-8 JSON bytes specifically for known idempotency request/consume body columns before serialization redaction. Keep arbitrary binary values hashed; preserve raw byte digest separately.

findings.title: Observer compares incompatible request hash algorithms
findings.actual: Core Hash(request) is sha256: plus RFC8785 canonical JSON SHA256. Observer uses unprefixed SHA256(raw stored JSON). Go struct marshaling order differs from canonical order, so adding prefix alone is insufficient. A 17-field ASCII/integer fixture stored as TEXT reaches ORIGINAL_REQUEST_HASH_MISMATCH.
findings.fix: Validate stored request_hash with the same strict canonical JSON/digest contract; retain original_request_body_sha256 solely as raw-byte provenance. Do not require raw-byte digest equality to semantic request hash.

findings.title: Run evidence lookup does not complete the claimed exact Run binding
findings.actual: The unique consumption receipt and qualification marker are checked, but profile_hash is selected without comparison; run_ref entity_type is not validated and actual domain Run rows are returned without cardinality or body task/runtime/epoch checks. A missing or contradictory Run object can still be emitted as an apparently observed original_run_id.
findings.fix: Require one Run with body id/project/task/runtime/lease_epoch matching the original request and qualification marker; validate run_ref type/id and marker profile_hash against original request. Keep missing/mismatch explicit instead of a success result.
findings.proof: Static source inspection only; no modified collector or real database tested

guards.readonly_database: mode=ro URI, query_only ON and check, BEGIN/ROLLBACK verified in source; fixtures db bytes unchanged
guards.unique_consumption: idempotency PK(principal,project,operation,key), <=1 consume, exact request hash/task/runtime and run_ref id checks exist, but unreachable until R1/R2 repaired
guards.budget_chain: Task.goal_id -> Goal.budget_policy_id -> exact GOAL/PROJECT/GLOBAL scopes and parent IDs, cycle/20 bound and known unlimited policy checks exist
guards.effective_budget_limit: Current effective revision only. Unlike budgetChain it does not resolve older domain_versions when current revision is future-effective. Explicit fail-closed assertion preserves missing coverage; cannot claim general effective-ancestry equivalence.
guards.goal_preconfirm: ACTIVE is correct for normal preparation: client_runtime_setup_windows.go:257 explicitly ACTIVATEs Goal before draft Task and plan creation; beginRuntimeQualification SUBMIT requires active Goal.
guards.goal_postconfirm: ACTIVE is a readiness/admission condition, not a universal retrospective observation invariant. observe.py:98 rejects post-confirm PAUSED/CANCELLED/completed goals and prevents later Run/effect evidence capture. Treat as supported-state limit or split readiness from read-only historical observation before using for those states.
guards.sensitive_fields: No credential-table queries; explicit session columns; Run lease_token_hash removed; source producer request/consume has only non-secret bindings and Run ref. Arbitrary byte cells are hashed; R1 fix must be limited to known non-secret JSON columns.
guards.electron_wait: Popen object retained and process.wait() numeric result records owned Electron process wait. It explicitly does not infer core/worker/verifier status. This is capability inspection only; launcher was not executed.
guards.append_only: out paths constrained to Root receipt subtree, exclusive create and bounded 2MiB output. Frozen helpers currently require D output; C staging does not make execution D-write-free.

verification.source_binding: three members exact hashes and sizes verified; source copies in inputs/
verification.fixture_assertions: two expected source-bound failures reproduced against newly created C databases only; fixture harness exit0 means both defects reproduced, not observer PASS
